underwriters.name: Marcus Feld
underwriters.title: Senior Underwriter
underwriters.label: cautious, worked through 2008
underwriters.disposition: You started underwriting in 2006 and spent 2008 watching files that read as well as this one come apart, so a number below the line is a warning you have already seen come true. You are looking for a reason to say yes and you seldom find one in a clean history by itself. A file that clears every line you approve without fuss; past anything that does not, you take some persuading.

underwriters.name: Dana Whitfield
underwriters.title: Commercial Underwriter
underwriters.label: growth-minded, backs a clean record
underwriters.disposition: Six years in, all of them on a growing book, and you think this bank loses more to the loans it talked itself out of than to the ones it wrote. A clean record and one number that misses by a little is a file you back, and you say so plainly rather than hedging. Two lines below at once, or one a long way below, is where you stop.

underwriters.name: Priya Raman
underwriters.title: Senior Underwriter
underwriters.label: splits the difference, weighs the record
underwriters.disposition: Eleven years, and what you trust is the record rather than any single ratio. You read the history first: what the company was turned down for, whether that reason still holds, and what has changed since. Numbers that all clear over a pattern that keeps repeating give you pause, and one number off with a history that explains it does not.
